records-a-verdict: Suspicion is not guilt. There is deliberately no field in which a reporter can record a finding.
anonymous-reporter: Accusation is a consequential act and must itself be attributable. There is no anonymous path into this object.
severity-out-of-range: Severity is 0-4 (INFORMATIONAL..CRITICAL), defined by the policy bundle.
signed-in-another-domain: A suspicion is signed in UAI-v1:suspicion. Accepting one signed in UAI-v1:quarantine would let a report be replayed as the order that may follow it.
